text:
Maria: Heads-up — PR #7812 is in the RC and it's blocking the cut. We need 2 approvals before the 18:00 PT cutoff. Small mem tuning + warmup change. @Aj @Devin can one of you take a quick second opinion? https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/7812

Aj: On it, will look in ~20m. Any specific smoke steps or things to watch for?

Maria: Quick smoke: `./scripts/smoke.sh --target=local` and watch prometheus -> kv-cache.* for memory spikes. Main risk is OOM under 8GB instances, and a missing nil-check I noticed earlier.

Devin: I can pair if Aj is tied up. Local test matrix: unit tests passed, e2e shows ~1.2% CPU perf regression in my run, but that looked noisy.

ReleaseBot: Merge hold: 2 approvals required. Cutoff set to 2026-03-17T18:00:00-07:00. Automated rollback plan attached to the release notes.

Aj: Left an inline comment on warmup.go about a potential nil deref on the warmup path. Maria please address or I'll request changes.

Maria: Pushed a tiny fix that adds the nil check and a test. PTAL @Aj @Devin.

Aj: Looks good to me now, thanks. :thumbsup:

Devin: LGTM from me as well — marking second eye. CI is green for my run.

Maria: Thank you both. I'll merge once the merge hold allows it. If we see any memory spike post-deploy, I'll revert to v1.18.4 and open an incident.

Aj: Sounds good. If anything odd shows up, ping #eng-sre and I'll jump on it.

ReleaseBot: Merge hold cleared (2 approvals).
thread_preview: Maria asks for 2 approvals before cutoff; Aj and Devin review, small nil-check fix pushed, both approve, merge hold cleared.
